turns.question: What are total sales per customer?
turns.resolved: What are the total sales per customer for Vertex Manufacturing across all available time?
turns.sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer,
       ROUND(SUM(so.total_amount), 2) AS total_sales
FROM sales_orders so
JOIN sales_customers c ON c.id = so.customer_id
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC, c.name

turns.question: Sales in December 2024 versus December 2025
turns.resolved: Compare total sales for Volume Perf in December 2024 (2024-12-01 through 2024-12-31) versus December 2025 (2025-12-01 through 2025-12-31).
turns.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (
    WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
  ), 0), 2) AS sales_december_2024,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount) FILTER (

  AND (
    (so.order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01')
    OR (so.order_date >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01')

turns.question: Which weekday gets the most orders?
turns.resolved: Which weekday has the most orders for Volume Perf, counting sales orders by order date across all available history?
turns.sql:
WITH weekday_orders AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(DOW FROM so.order_date)::int AS weekday_number,
        COUNT(*) AS orders
    FROM sales_orders so
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM so.order_date)::int
)
SELECT
    CASE wo.weekday_number
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday'
    END AS weekday,
    wo.orders
FROM weekday_orders wo
ORDER BY wo.orders DESC, wo.weekday_number
LIMIT 1

turns.question: List all revenue and expense accounts with their balances
turns.resolved: List all revenue and expense accounts for Acme and their balances as of 2026-09-27.
turns.sql:
WITH account_balances AS (
    SELECT jl.account_id,
           SUM(
               CASE
                   WHEN a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
                       THEN jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount
                   WHEN a.account_type = 'EXPENSE'
                       THEN jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount
               END
           ) AS balance
    FROM fin_journal_lines jl
    JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
    WHERE jl.is_posted
      AND jl.posting_date <= DATE '2026-09-27'
      AND a.account_type IN ('REVENUE', 'EXPENSE')
    GROUP BY jl.account_id
)
SELECT a.code AS account_code,
       a.name AS account_name,
       a.account_type,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ab.balance, 0), 2) AS balance
FROM fin_accounts a
LEFT JOIN account_balances ab ON ab.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.account_type IN ('REVENUE', 'EXPENSE')
ORDER BY a.code
confidence_reasons: grouped by 'account' but column 'account_type' repeats, so the result is finer-grained than requested

turns.question: Which of those months had the best margin?
turns.resolved: For Volume Perf, which single month had the highest gross margin percentage among July, August, September, October, November, and December 2025, using revenue and cost of goods sold?
turns.sql:
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date AS month,
           COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount)
               FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'REVENUE'), 0) AS revenue,
           COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount)
               FILTER (WHERE a.id IN (
                   SELECT ic.cogs_account_id
                   FROM inv_item_categories ic
               )), 0) AS cost_of_goods_sold
    FROM fin_journal_lines jl
    JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
    WHERE jl.is_posted
      AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-07-01'
      AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND (
          a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
          OR a.id IN (
              SELECT ic.cogs_account_id
              FROM inv_item_categories ic
          )
      )
    GROUP BY date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date
)
SELECT mt.month,
       ROUND(100.0 * (mt.revenue - mt.cost_of_goods_sold) / NULLIF(mt.revenue, 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM monthly_totals mt
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 1
